answers.reason: As a junior professor without a central leadership office or senior rank, they are not automatically entitled to a seat in the central university senate.
Central budget allocation is restricted to the university leadership, central administration, and faculty heads.
As a professor, the junior professor holds the required academic rank to serve on a faculty appointment committee.
Holding a professorship entitles the junior professor to participate in the governance of their faculty on the faculty council.
As a teaching professor in the faculty, the junior professor has the rank to take part in faculty committees on teaching.
As a professor, the junior professor is qualified and permitted to sit on the faculty's examination board.
Leading a research group as a professor entitles the junior professor to participate in the faculty's internal research funding decisions.
Because the junior professor teaches in the faculty and outranks working group level, they may participate in revising module descriptions.
As a professor who teaches and leads a research group, the junior professor has the rank to take part in lower-level teaching laboratory procurement.
Holding a professorial office allows the junior professor to participate in lower-level faculty planning rounds like orientation week.
